parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true and reside in Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistFetcherTests.swift. The two methods — fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnError (line 45) and fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnURLError (line 65) — are distinct test cases that exercise different error conditions (a generic error vs. a URLError); their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.8) reflects the natural parallelism of error-path test cases, not unintentional duplication. Consolidating them would obscure which specific failure mode each test guards against, reducing diagnostic clarity when one fails.
